title: How Saying It Out Loud Kills What You've Been Hiding
caption:
A godly man says it before it kills him. What you hide grows. What you confess starts to die.

Pick one man, not the group chat. Say the sin, not the story around it. Let him ask you next week, not just once. Meet his confession with grace, not a lecture, so the next brother trusts it enough to try.

Confess your sins to one another, that you may be healed.
